Kibana is part of 5 of my public repositories, from 2017 to 2025.

What it was for: [Learning and experiments](@/projects/learning.md) (2), [Systems and infrastructure](@/projects/systems.md) (2) and [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (1).

Most recently: [microcrawler-js](@/work/microcrawler-js.md): Scrapping made easy; [happ](@/work/happ.md): Playground App created during my Hospital Stay; [server-ansible](@/work/server-ansible.md): Server Ansible.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Kibana: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Kibana to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
